question: What powers arise from this practice according to the teaching to the beloved?
premises: Hearing at a distance is one attainment
Paralysis of bonds is another attainment
inference: The practice grants knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the paralysis of bonds, O beloved.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may mean arresting or stunning bonds or fetters.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains the knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
